amendments.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a)
amendments.summary: This amendment addresses changes in the exclusion criteria in response to FDA feedback based on in vitro data currently available.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 1
changes.summary: Added sub-section headers.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 2
changes.summary: In first paragraph, added text for the effect of LY3526318 on other drugs.
changes.rationale: Clarification of the potential of LY3526318 exposure to affect metabolism of other drugs.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 3
changes.summary: Updated first bullet to specify CYP3A4, plus minor editorial changes.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 4
changes.summary: Added a bullet for CYP3A4 and p-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrates.
changes.rationale: Based on in vitro data suggesting a potential for PK interactions.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 5
changes.summary: Updated numbers for inclusion and exclusion criteria.
changes.rationale: To align with master protocol and ISA numbering system.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 6
changes.summary: Updated criterion #2051 to specify drugs taken orally or intravenously.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 7
changes.summary: Added exclusion criterion #2054 for participants that are taking drugs that are sensitive CYP3A4 substrates with a narrow therapeutic index.
changes.rationale: Based on in vitro data suggesting potential CYP3A4 inhibition at the proposed LY3526318 dose.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 8
changes.summary: Added exclusion criterion #2055 for participants that are taking simvastatin at doses greater than 20 mg/day.
changes.rationale: Simvastatin is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate, with a projected maximal increase in exposure <2-fold in combination with LY3526318. Therefore, doses of 20 mg or less are considered safe.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 9
changes.summary: Added exclusion criterion #2056 for participants that are taking metformin at doses greater than 1000 mg/day.
changes.rationale: Based on limited data related to inhibition of renal transporters.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 10
changes.summary: Added exclusion criterion #2057 for participants that are taking digoxin.
changes.rationale: Based on in vitro data suggesting a potential for LY3526318 to inhibit P-gp.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 11
changes.summary: Under Potential Drug-Drug Interactions with LY3526318, added reference to Section 5.2 for concomitant medication restrictions.

changes.name: H0P-MC-BP02(a) row 12
changes.summary: Added reference to Section 5.2 and the Manual of Operations for additional information.
changes.rationale: Additional information for excluded concomitant medications are listed in Section 5.2 and the Manual of Operations.
